title: Blueprint project statistics
description: The JSON form of Informal.Stats.ProjectStats (src/VersoBlueprint/Stats/Data.lean), schema version 2. Paths are relative to the project root with '/' separators; lists have a fixed order; there is no version-control data. Optional values are present as null.

layout.description: Where the statistics looked: source directories that hold the project's modules, and library directories of the workspace's packages inside the project.

modules.description: The project's modules in the checked environment, sorted by name.

declarations.description: Declarations of the project's modules by kind; declarations Lean generates (constructors, recursors, projections, equation lemmas, matchers, internal names) are not counted.

sources.description: Every .lean file under the project root outside hidden directories (such as .lake), sorted by path, and the sum of their lines.

status.description: imported: a module of the environment the site was generated from; compiled: not imported, but a library directory holds its .olean; notBuilt: neither.

chapters.description: Progress by chapter (the first directory of the nodes' page addresses), in order of first appearance. Empty until the site's pages are known.

graph.description: The size of the dependency graph; placeholders for unknown references are not nodes.

edges.description: Distinct dependent-dependency pairs on either axis.

byKind.description: [kind, count] pairs in the order definition, proposition, lemma, theorem, corollary; kinds without nodes are left out.

trust.description: What the proofs rest on beyond Lean's standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), node by node. Lists are sorted by label, then declaration.

headline.description: The project's headline result: the theorems its Comparator challenge states, compared with the solution. Null when the project has no Comparator challenge.

hasComparatorChallenge.description: Whether the project has a Comparator challenge: comparator.json at the root, or the source of Comparator.Challenge. Without one a page can say that a challenge would add a headline.

correspondence.description: How a declaration of the challenge compares with the solution's declaration of the same name: the same (for a theorem the same statement, for anything else the same declaration including its value, and the same for every declaration of the challenge its statement uses), a definition hole whose value the solution supplies, differs, missing from the solution, or not compared (headline.unavailable says why).

headline.description: A Comparator challenge as lake comparator reads it: comparator.json at the project root (challenge_module, solution_module, theorem_names, definition_names, permitted_axioms), or else the modules Comparator.Challenge and Comparator.Solution with every theorem of the challenge judged and no axiom list.

config.description: comparator.json when the challenge is configured by it; null for the default modules.

permittedAxioms.description: The axioms the challenge permits, when it states them.

unavailable.description: Why no comparison could be made: comparator.json is invalid; the challenge's compiled module is missing, does not match its source, or is unreadable; the environment of the site lacks the solution module or a module the challenge imports. Null when the comparison was made.

unavailableDetail.description: The module, file or error message behind unavailable.

theorems.description: The theorems judged (theorem_names, or every theorem of the challenge), in source order.

docstring.description: The challenge's docstring, as written without its delimiters.

statement.description: The statement as written in the challenge, from its keyword to the end of the signature; empty without the source.

differingDeclaration.description: When solution is differs: the first declaration found to differ, the theorem itself or a declaration of the challenge its statement uses.

difference.description: When solution is differs: how, in a few words.

sorryFree.description: Whether the solution's declaration is free of sorry, directly or through what it uses; null when the solution has none.

axioms.description: The axioms the solution's declaration depends on: sorryAx first, then other axioms, compiled-code axioms, the standard three.

axiomsPermitted.description: Whether every axiom is in permittedAxioms; null without a list.

proved.description: The same statement, proved without sorry.

node.description: The Blueprint node whose Lean declarations include the theorem.

definitions.description: The other declarations the challenge introduces, in source order.

name.description: A Lean name as Lean prints it, with « » around components that need them.

lineCounts.description: Physical lines: whitespace only (blank), comment text only (comment: line comments, nested block comments, docstrings) or anything else (code).

progress.description: Nodes by the dependency graph's fill status.

axioms.description: The axioms that put the declaration on this row.

identity.description: What the files at the project root say: the root package name in lake-manifest.json, the README's first heading and first prose paragraph (plain text), the license file with an SPDX guess (null: no license file), lean-toolchain and the locked packages in manifest order.

url.description: Without any user name or password.
